items.title: Show HN: How to build and self-host a code review agent
items.summary: Hey HN, I've had a side-project that I've slowly ticked away at over the last year called Tilde. Tilde is a harness SDK platform - I've tried to take the best things of OpenClaw, Hermes & other harnesses and decompose them and make them available as cloud API building blocks. You can use Tilde to create AI agents for your use case, fast and self-host the agent's yourself. The documentation (and attached blog post) leave a lot to be desired in terms of technical documentation but hopefully the attached git repo does a good job of showcasing the API. https://github.com/trytilde/examples Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49128177 Points: 10 # Comments: 3
